summary: Document checkout-bound execution and distinguish static checks from runtime admission

delivery.outcome: Publish an independently reviewable proposed execution profile with exact candidate source references and explicit non-adoption status.
nonGoals: No global runtime replacement, protected profile change, source move, historical data migration or claim of universal shell interception.

architecture.decision: Document the single launcher owned by ticket-067 and separate its admission checks from static conformance, interpreter provenance, trust and deployment. Preserve existing external protected tool/receipt stores.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded documentation change through protected publication; no persistent data or deployment changes.

validation.evidence: Managed gate, valid JSON frontmatter and document/index link checks; refer to ticket-067 for executable qualification.
